# Security for Tool-Using Agents {#sec-agent-security}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- state the agent threat model as an authorization problem, not a content-filtering problem;
- recognise the lethal trifecta in a system design before it ships;
- explain why classifier-based injection defences fail under adaptive attack;
- apply out-of-band controls: capabilities, information-flow labels, sandboxing, egress policy.

## Exercises

1. Audit an agent you have built against the lethal trifecta. Which leg would you remove, and what does the product lose?
2. Write an indirect injection that would work against your own system. Then implement one out-of-band control and re-test.
